info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-Delete Retail Orders Cancel-v4-spec
info.description: The Retail Order Cancellation API enables businesses to efficiently manage the cancellation of retail orders. Using this endpoint, service providers can remove specific orders that have been marked for cancellation, ensuring accurate order management and inventory control. This functionality is essential for retail applications that require updates to order status. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that need to maintain order integrity and customer satisfaction.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel an order that has been placed. Make sure to provide the correct order identifier to successfully process the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the order details to be canceled. Ensure that the provided order information is accurate to successfully process the cancellation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelRequest.description: A request body for cancelling an order. The value should indicate the reason for the cancellation.

status.description: Indicates whether the cancel operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the order being canceled.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the order after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message related to the cancellation operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the cancellation operation.

DeleteRetailOrdersCancelResponse_202.description: Response schema for canceling an order operation.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who initiated the cancellation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the order cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the operations performed.

x-processing-time.description: The total time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. This value can help in performance monitoring and optimization.
